### Added

- (gs) [Add the Platform cluster page's RBAC tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3636) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Where the Platform section is turned on (`gs.features.platformSection.enabled`), a management cluster's page has an RBAC tab showing who can do what in the cluster, as the classic cluster page does. Workload clusters have no such tab.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.47.1...v3.48.0
